lifecycle: The compiled optional host creates an independent decoder only for a fresh connected own 2026 hero deployment. Exit, identity/session/rule retirement or disable joins the decoder worker and clears old images. Missing EncodedVideoFactory disables only this feature. Primary UDP/MQTT/QML remain independent.
contract: CustomByteBlock.data contains up to300 bytes at up to50Hz. Explicit annexb or compact framing; no format sniffing, serial CRC invention, ROS sequence fields or synthetic trajectories. EncodedVideoFactory/1.0 creates a new unparented UI-thread endpoint; EncodedVideoInput/1.0 admits bounded compressed bytes and clears prior images on discontinuity. The manifest describes this compiled feature; it is not a native library discovery record or an installable rmplugin package.
